(() => {
  const result={};
  const node=document.createElement('div');
  node.style.cssText='font:normal 500 16px/20px serif';
  node.textContent='alpha beta';
  document.body.append(node);
  for(const weight of [-1,0,1001]){
    node.style.fontWeight='500';
    node.style.fontWeight=String(weight);
    result['invalid-weight-'+weight]=node.style.fontWeight==='500' && getComputedStyle(node).fontWeight==='500' && !CSS.supports('font-weight',String(weight));
  }
  node.style.font='1001 16px serif';
  result.invalidShorthand=getComputedStyle(node).fontWeight==='500' && !CSS.supports('font','1001 16px serif');
  node.style.fontWeight='3.14';
  result.fractional=getComputedStyle(node).fontWeight==='3.14';
  node.style.fontStyle='italic';
  node.style.fontStyle='oblique 91deg';
  result.invalidAngle=getComputedStyle(node).fontStyle==='italic' && !CSS.supports('font-style','oblique 91deg');
  node.style.fontStyle='oblique 0.25turn';
  result.angle=getComputedStyle(node).fontStyle==='oblique 90deg';
  try{node.getBoundingClientRect();result.oblique=false;}
  catch(error){result.oblique=error.message.includes('text font synthesis or spacing');}
  node.style.fontStyle='normal';
  node.style.fontWeight='400';
  node.innerHTML='alpha <i>beta</i>';
  try{node.querySelector('i').getBoundingClientRect();result.fragment=false;}
  catch(error){result.fragment=error.message.includes('inline fragment geometry');}
  const sheet=document.createElement('style');sheet.textContent='i::before{content:"icon"}';document.head.append(sheet);
  try{node.getBoundingClientRect();result.generated=false;}
  catch(error){result.generated=error.message.includes('generated content in inline text');}
  sheet.remove();
  const foreign=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','i');foreign.textContent='alpha';document.body.append(foreign);
  result.namespaceDefault=getComputedStyle(foreign).fontStyle==='normal';
  try{foreign.getBoundingClientRect();result.namespace=false;}
  catch(error){result.namespace=error.message.includes('SVG');}
  foreign.remove();
  const unsupported=document.createElement('table');document.body.append(unsupported);
  try{unsupported.getBoundingClientRect();result.table=false;}
  catch(error){result.table=error.message.includes('unsupported HTML tag');}
  unsupported.remove();
  node.innerHTML='<i style="font-style:normal">alpha</i>';
  node.style.display='inline-block';
  node.firstElementChild.style.display='inline-block';
  const outer=node.getBoundingClientRect(),inner=node.firstElementChild.getBoundingClientRect();
  result.nestedAtomic=outer.height===20&&inner.height===20&&outer.width===inner.width&&inner.width>0;
  node.style.display='block';
  node.firstElementChild.style.cssText='font-style:italic';
  result.recovery=node.getBoundingClientRect().height===20;
  node.remove();
  return result;
})()
